findings.facts: 001 check3: report.md needle constructed incorrectly (two false 'missing' problems); owner report.md contains the exact C01 strings. 004 check9 oracle: (a) nonsense constant-cumulative assertion (11,893 false problems on owner-r1), (b) string/int j (TypeError), (c) pair-count formula double-multiplied by 3; all three fixed and disclosed, then OK on owner-r1. 004/005 check8: latent dict|set TypeError (that script had never run to that point); fixed in the 007 corrected copy. 005 supervision attempt 1: missing --output forwarding to the worker and a bad t1 setup; preserved with raw exits; attempt 2 all 7/7. 005 launcher/plugin first run: plugin-instance registration did not register module fixtures (272-failure run preserved in 002 logs); fixed to module plugin.
findings.status: all disclosed; final tools validated before reliance
